$comment: The stage-id registry of §6.1 — versioned data inside @plat/kernel (C-0005), append-only: stage ids are u16, each row keeps the id it was appended with, never renumbered or reused; adding one moves no existing key. M0 registers the base's stages in §4.1's drawn order, then S7c, S9b and S8.seed (C-0020); the evolution engine's EVO_* stages and the village product's VS* stages are appended when their milestones land. STAGE_VIEW (0xffff) is reserved for paint programs and furniture and is no row. `title` is §4.1's; `reservedUntil` is set where the design itself places a stage's registration or first user after M0 (§4.1: S7c and S9b are stage 2's, M5; SKY is the sky layer's, M6-sky; §6.1: S8.seed's first user M5). Item M0-d-01.
